body:
Hi Maxime,

Thanks for your question ('When should IT equipment be ordered for a new hire?'). Short answer: IT equipment is ordered 10 working days before the start date and the manager sends the welcome plan 5 working days before the start date.

The policy on SharePoint has the details. Let me know if anything is unclear.

Best,
Sofie Claes
HR Policy Manager, HR
